mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand cycles characterized by rising residential investment, improved corporate revenue outlook drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as strong consumer demand cycles (HOUST > 1000 for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment and residential sales signals strong housing market activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both increase simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), aggressive monetary tightening risks reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
